topic: Slope Stability & Landslide Shear Plane Mechanics

topic: Triad Controls of Aeolian Sediment Transport

topic: Tectonic Activity Indices in Drainage Basin Analysis

correct_text: (i), (ii), (iii) and (iv) [All 4 indices constitute the classic Keller & Pinter morphotectonic index suite]

question: An isolated erosional rock mass comprising a slender stem, neck or column supporting a wider cap is known as: (i) Pedestal rocks, (ii) Mushroom rocks, (iii) Balanced rocks, (iv) Perched blocks. Choose the correct set of answer from the following options :

question: Optically Stimulated Luminescence (OSL) dating methods are useful for determining the age of: (i) Naturally occurring sediments, (ii) Man-made materials like pottery, (iii) Intrusive igneous rocks, (iv) Metasedimentary rocks. Choose the correct set of answer from the following options :

topic: Fluvial Megafans vs Alluvial Fans in Foreland Basins

Choose the correct set of answer from the following options :
correct_text: (i), (ii), (iv) [Megafans are distinguished by massive scale (>10^4 km2) and low slope (<0.1 deg), distinct from alluvial fans]

options.D: The P wave is reflected from the crust-mantle boundary.

options.D: All the features of Earth's surface are at the same elevation

correct_text: A buoyancy force pushing the lithosphere up equals the gravitational force pushing it down. (Hydrostatic balance: Upward asthenospheric buoyancy = Downward lithospheric weight)
